integrity: All finite conditional identities proved from the matching transition; functional convergence uses tightness, averaged generator convergence and uniqueness of the immigration–death martingale problem, not finite numerical inference.
scientific_limitations: Uniform stationary perfect matchings only; forced uniform two-pair switches; no error rate for functional convergence; historical priority against broad generic local-process results remains uncertain.
title: Immigration–death dynamics of simple chords under stationary two-pair rewiring
